about: Inventory encoding for Tongari Boushi to Oshare na Mahou Tsukai (NDS). The 6-byte inventory records at slot B body 0x1D9B6 store a u16 LE 'stored_value' which is the game's internal item-ID, not the itemname.ofs positional iid. iid (0..3345) maps to stored_value via ascending-sorted internal IDs across 39 categories. Discovered by tracing ARM9 lookup function 0x0200BB2C and per-category tables at RAM 0x0209CCC4 (u16 bases) / 0x0209CD14 (u32 counts) / 0x0209CC9C (u8 iteration order).
method: Per-category internal-ID base+count tables in ARM9 define 39 categories with disjoint internal-ID ranges (cat 0: 10000..10021, cat 1: 1..15, cat 2: 30..164, ..., cat 38: 5830..5840). Sum of all counts = 3346 = itemname.ofs entry count. The itemname.ofs is ordered by ascending internal-ID, so iid N corresponds to the N-th smallest internal-ID. stored_value = sorted_internal_ids[iid].

tables.save_slot_inventory_record_format: u16 stored_value LE, 3 bytes 0x00, u8 quantity (6 bytes total)

verified_against.name: King Oyster Mushroom
verified_against.note: Tyler's brief said iid 263 but the EN-patched itemname.ofs has 'King Oyster Mushroom' at iid 262 (JP エリンギ). iid 263 in the EN patch is 'Rosso Coral Mushroom' (JP ホウキタケ).
